name: review-py-local-fork
title: Pack refresh destroys the local review.py stale-cache fix
description: scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py carries a local fix (bc01bc2) that no upstream version has: _resolve_check recomputes the deterministic sd-check every run instead of serving a cached report. The file is install: "always", so every pack refresh reverts the fix. Confirmed by refreshing 0.64.3 to 0.64.27, which reverted it and failed the five guard tests in tests/test_review_coordinator.py. Blocks the pack refresh until the fix is durable: either the behaviour lands upstream, or the fork is recorded so a refresh is a deliberate decision that re-applies it. Upstreaming is the only route that survives a refresh, but an upstream PR is approval-gated, so recording is a legitimate terminal outcome. Eighth instance of the vendored-artifact pattern, and the first where a refresh destroys a working fix rather than merely leaving a defect unfixed.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Local fork of a vendored install: "always" file: bc01bc2 added _resolve_check (recompute the deterministic sd-check every run) and tests/test_review_coordinator.py; 4d62cd9 re-recorded provenance so the install audit stays green. The symbol exists in no upstream version -- checked all 33 v0.6* tags across 1975 commits -- so this is a fork, not a reverted upstream change. Confirmed 2026-08-07 by refreshing 0.64.3 to 0.64.27: the fix was reverted and the 5 ResolveCheckTest tests errored; refresh then reverted. Eighth instance of the vendored-artifact pattern whose canonical membership table lives in 08-07-vendored-artifact-upstream-route/prd.md, and the first where a refresh destroys a working fix rather than leaving a defect unfixed. Blocks the pack refresh until the fork is durable -- upstreamed, or recorded with a re-apply step. Recording is terminal, not a partial failure. Upstream fix tracked separately in sd-ai-command-pack; no upstream PR opened. Deliverable is .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md, named in a Requirement, which makes this the eleventh member of that landing cluster and moves the P2 band from 5-60 to 5-70; ten sibling task.json notes restate the old count or band and are derived.
